brief: Haverhill's drought and water supply emergency: reservoir levels at Kenoza Lake, Crystal Lake and Millvale Reservoir; the City's outdoor watering bans and water use restriction ordinance; MassDEP's declaration of a water supply emergency; emergency and backup supplies such as a connection to Methuen, test wells and drawing from the Merrimack River; tiered water rates; and rainfall and drought status for northeastern Massachusetts.
